nativeWelcome.title: Welcome to the new eStundnzettl!
nativeWelcome.body: Hi! Your app has been rebuilt from the ground up — the previous web-based shell is now a true native Android app. Why the switch? The old foundation was a good start, but you could feel it: at launch, while scrolling, on battery. The new version starts faster, runs smoother and is ready for everything ahead. Your data has been migrated automatically — everything is right where it belongs.

intro.badge: Hi there, great to have you!
intro.body: eStundnzettl records your working time right on your phone. At the end of the month, the app turns it into a clean timesheet. No rocket science: simply follow these points in order — you cannot break anything.

firstSteps.title: First: what is where?
firstSteps.addBody: The round green button at the bottom right is your most important button. A quick tap opens the form where you enter your working time.
firstSteps.reportBody: The icon at the top right opens the preview. Here you check your hours and later send the finished PDF.
firstSteps.settingsBody: This is where you find your name, work schedule, backups and the app's appearance. Tap cards with an arrow to open them.
firstSteps.gestureHint: Tap means touch once and let go. Press and hold means leave your finger there for about one second. Swipe means place your finger down and slide it across the screen.

step1.title: Track your hours
step1.lead: Two ways to get there — pick whichever suits you:
step1.timerBody: In the morning: place your finger on the green <plus>+</plus> button, hold it there briefly and slide it upward. Let go when the timer appears. At the end of the day, tap the timer and confirm. The app fills in start, end and duration.
step1.manualBody: Tap the + button once. First choose the type of entry, then start, end and break. Finally tap "Save" at the bottom. "Same as last" copies the times from your previous entry.

step2.title: Travel times
step2.lead: When adding an entry, choose the type "Drive" at the top — there are two kinds:
step2.arrival: Arrival/departure: Counts as paid working time — goes into the daily target.
step2.drive: Travel time: Unpaid travel — listed separately on the timesheet.

step3.title: Vacation, sick & comp time
step3.body: Just pick Vacation, Sick or Comp time when adding an entry — that is all. The app automatically applies the correct target hours for the day, and your remaining vacation shows right on the monthly PDF. You can also enter custom times if needed.

step4.title: Attach documents
step4.body: Work order, delivery note or photo from the site: open the entry and tap "Documents". Then choose a photo or file from your phone. You can include the attachments when exporting the PDF.

step5.title: Month end & PDF
step5.preview: Tap the green <icon/> icon at the top right. You will see a preview of your finished timesheet — filtered by month or calendar week. Pinch with two fingers to zoom in, and use the speech-bubble icon to add a note for your boss if you like.
step5.share: All good? Tap "Send" — via email, WhatsApp, or save it as a file. And the month is done!

step6.title: Backup — better safe than sorry
step6.lead: Phone broken or lost — and your hours gone? No way! Turn on automatic backups, it takes less than a minute:
step6.gdriveBody: Connect your Google account in Settings under "Backup & Export" — from then on the app backs up to your cloud every day by itself. On a new phone, just tap "I already have a backup" at the start and everything comes right back.
step6.localBody: Also works without internet: choose a backup folder on your phone once. Important: if the phone is lost, that folder is lost too — Google Drive or Nextcloud is safer for that case.

step7.title: Hausmasta mode
step7.lead: For everyone who wants the full picture: enable Advanced settings at the very bottom of the settings — we lovingly call it Hausmasta mode. It reveals the pro tools:
step7.nextcloud: Nextcloud backup — back up to your own cloud
step7.jsonIO: Import & export — save and restore your data as a file
step7.pdfArchive: PDF archive — automatically stores a PDF every month for legal record keeping
step7.codes: Work codes — short labels for tasks, for example M for assembly; also available in Settings without Hausmasta mode
step7.recordOnly: Recording only — track hours without any target/actual math

newFeatures.title: Good to know — new & useful
newFeatures.nightBody: You can enter 22:00 to 06:00, for example. The app understands that 06:00 means the next morning. A small ⁺¹ next to the end time reminds you.
newFeatures.materialBody: Enable Material You under Settings → Appearance. The app then uses colors from your Android phone. This only changes the look, never your data.
newFeatures.tourTitle: Let the app show you around
newFeatures.tourBody: On first launch, small hints highlight the important buttons. Settings has its own tour too. Tap "Next" until it is done — the tour does not change any setting.
newFeatures.restoreBody: Choose "I already have a backup" during setup. A complete backup restores entries, your name, settings, work codes and attachments. Read the summary before confirming.

tips.title: Tips & tricks
tips.deleteBody: Place your finger on an entry and drag it to the left. The app asks for confirmation before deleting it.
tips.editBody: Just tap an entry to change it.
tips.autoBackupBody: Once connected, the app backs up daily by itself. Nothing left to do.
tips.themeBody: Light, dark or follow the system — set it under Appearance.
